## Design

### 2026-10-19 – October 19th: Idea set

**2h**

October 19th: Idea set

Instruments. Instruments are nice to listen and most like guitar and piano do one thing. Playing chords. Playing chords is essential when trying to play a piece or sing along to a song. This is why I designed Chordial.
